ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Abans Enterprises Limited announced a change in statutory auditors for its material subsidiary, Abans Gems and Jewels Trading FZC (AGJT), effective August 13, 2026. The outgoing auditor, M/s. Abdulaziz Panis and Shah Associates, cited "pre-occupation" as the reason for resignation, explicitly confirming no other undisclosed issues or concerns with management. M/s. Al Jeroudy Accounting & Auditing L.L.C was simultaneously appointed to ensure audit continuity, and the document presents no immediate red flags beyond the routine scrutiny warranted by an auditor change.
